replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, absolutely. The pressure of exams or complex problems triggers real anxiety for me. replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I tried using an AI tutor last year for calculus. Initially, it felt overwhelming with too much information at once. replies.How would you explain, step by step, how: First, identify the coefficients of your quadratic equation in standard form ax² + bx + c = 0. Then apply the quadratic formula: x equals negative b plus or minus the square root of b squared minus four ac, all divided by two a. Finally, simplify each solution to find your roots.

To find stationary points, first calculate the derivative of f(x) with respect to x. Set this derivative equal to zero and solve for x values. Then substitute these x values back into the original function to get corresponding y coordinates. These points represent where the slope is zero.
